units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:7:2">Y. Taan. IV, end, 69ᶜ</cite> <he>בטל הח׳</he> the grave-digging (for the generation of the wilderness) ceased; Lam. R. introd. (R. Z’era). Y. l. c. <he>צאו לח׳</he> go out for grave-digging; (Lam. R. l. c.; Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII, end <he>לַחְפּוֹר</he>).
